raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "gtk-4-fortran" %}
{% set version = "4.9.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/vmagnin/gtk-fortran/archive/refs/tags/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: addeb090ff4bdfd027db1f9c3729310f90b9f6f23560e07051b5f596dfe42b22

build:
  number: 0
  skip: true  # [win]
  script:
    - set -ex
    - export FFLAGS="${FFLAGS} -ffree-line-length-none"
    - cmake ${CMAKE_ARGS} -B_build -GNinja
    - cmake --build _build
    - ctest --test-dir _build -R '^(regex|pixbuf_without_gui|tests)$'
    - cmake --install _build
  run_exports:
    - {{ pin_subpackage(name, max_pin='x') }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    - plplot

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}
    - {{ compiler('fortran') }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - pkg-config
  host:
    - expat
    - glib
    - gtk4
    - plplot
  run:
    - gdk-pixbuf
    - cairo

test:
  requires:
    - pkg-config
  commands:
    - pkg-config --exact-version {{ version }} {{ name }}
    - test -f $PREFIX/lib/lib{{ name }}$SHLIB_EXT  # [unix]

about:
  home: https://github.com/vmagnin/gtk-fortran
  doc_url: https://github.com/vmagnin/gtk-fortran/wiki
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - LICENSE_EXCEPTION
  summary: GTK / Fortran bindings
  description: |
    The gtk-fortran project provides bindings to the Fortran language
    for the GTK libraries (GTK, Cairo, GdkPixbuf, GLib...) and is 
    licensed under GNU GPLv3. Like GTK and Fortran, it is
    cross-platform (Linux, macOS, BSD, Windows).

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - awvwgk
    - vmagnin
